Le subagent `ux-designer` a terminé l'audit. Voici son rapport, retransmis verbatim : --- # UX Accessibility & Heuristic Audit — `tools/bench-agent-cost/fixtures/design_target.html` Procedure followed: `agents/ux-designer.md` (Moves 1–6) and `skills/design/design.md` (WCAG 2.2 AA, Nielsen's 10). Read-only audit — file not modified. ## Summary Audit of a synthetic "Account Settings" form fixture (4 lines of markup, deliberately planted violations per file header). Found **7 distinct WCAG 2.2 AA violations** (two more than the four the fixture's own comments claim — the empty `aria-label` and the missing error-association are additional, undocumented defects) plus multiple Nielsen heuristic failures. ## User and task (Move 1) - User segment: account holder correcting an invalid email during account settings edit — includes screen-reader users and keyboard-only users. - Task: enter/correct an email address and save the change. - Success criterion: field labeled and error state perceivable/operable by all input modalities; save action reachable by keyboard; ≤1 error round-trip. - Failure modes: screen reader announces nothing for the input's purpose; screen reader never announces the error at all; keyboard user cannot reach "Save changes"; low-vision/colorblind user can't perceive the error; touch user with motor impairment cannot hit the 16×16 close target. ## Stakes classification - Classification: **High** - Criterion: accessibility-critical form (Move 2 — "accessibility-critical forms" is enumerated as High stakes) — full Moves 1–6 discipline applies, no shortcuts. --- ## Violations | # | Element (locator) | Criterion | Severity | Minimal fix | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | `` (line 13) | **WCAG 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions** (AA) + **1.3.1 Info and Relationships** (A) — placeholder is not a persistent label and is not programmatically associated with the input | Serious | Add `` and `id="email"` on the input; placeholder becomes an optional format hint, not the label. | | 2 | `Invalid format` (line 17) | **WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color** (A) — status conveyed by color alone, no icon or text status word | Serious | Add a non-color cue: `Error: Invalid format` or an icon with `aria-hidden="true"` plus visible text "Error". | | 3 | Same `` (line 17) | **WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification** (A) — error text exists but is not programmatically associated with the input it describes (no `aria-describedby`, no `role="alert"`/live region), so a screen-reader user editing the field is never told an error exists | Serious | Give the span an `id` and reference it from the input via `aria-describedby="email-error"`; mark the span `role="alert"` (or wrap in an `aria-live="polite"` region) so it is announced on error. | | 4 | `
